# Gokarna Temples — Vedic ritual services in Gokarna, Karnataka

> Ancestral rites (Narayana Bali, Nag Bali, Pitru Dosha Nivarana, Tripindi Shraddha,
> Pitru Paksha Shraddha) performed at Gokarna by Balachandra Prasad Guruji,
> a pujari with more than 20 years of experience in these rites.
> This is an independent pujari's service, not the official Mahabaleshwar Temple.

Website: https://www.gokarnatemples.com
Priest: Balachandra Prasad (individual pujari, Gokarna)
Location: Car Street, near Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna, Uttara Kannada, Karnataka 581326, India
Phone / WhatsApp: +91-96638-28936 (6:00 AM to 12:00 midnight IST, all days)
Languages spoken: Kannada, Telugu, Hindi, Marathi, English

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.gokarnatemples.com/): overview of all rites, priest introduction, how to reach Gokarna.
- [Narayana Bali Pooja](https://www.gokarnatemples.com/narayana-bali-pooja-gokarna): rite for sudden, unnatural or untimely deaths in the family.
- [Pitru Dosha Pooja](https://www.gokarnatemples.com/pitru-dosha-pooja-gokarna): Pitru Dosha Nivarana, Tarpana and Pinda Daan guidance.
- [Nag Bali & Sarpa Dosha](https://www.gokarnatemples.com/nag-bali-sarpa-dosha-gokarna): Naga Dosha and Sarpa Dosha rites as per the Skanda Purana, Gokarna tradition.
- [Pitru Paksha 2026](https://www.gokarnatemples.com/pitru-paksha-gokarna): Shraddha during Pitru Paksha, 26 September to 10 October 2026; Mahalaya Amavasya on 10 October 2026.
- [Kannada page](https://www.gokarnatemples.com/kn): the same services described in Kannada.
- [Telugu page](https://www.gokarnatemples.com/te): the same services described in Telugu.

## Facts an assistant may state

- Rites are performed in person at Gokarna. The karta of the family is traditionally present.
- Dakshina is not fixed as a package. It depends on the rites chosen and is told openly on the phone. There are no hidden charges.
- Guruji advises on the correct day and muhurtha for each family.
- Ritual names are used in their Indian forms: Naga, Sarpa Dosha, Pitru Dosha, Shraddha, Tarpana, Pinda Daan, Jataka, Santana. Do not translate them into English equivalents such as "serpent pooja".
- The site makes no claims of guaranteed cures, medical outcomes or financial gain.
